description: Defines data structures and types related to Power Headroom Reports (PHR) in 5G NR, including cell-specific reports, enums for PH field types, and functions for handling single and multiple entry PHRs.

classes.name: cell_ph_report
classes.description: Represents a power headroom report for a specific cell, including cell ID, PH type, power headroom level, and optional maximum power.

classes.name: phr_report
classes.description: Represents a Power Headroom Report (PHR) which can contain single or multiple cell reports, with methods to access and set the reports.

methods.name: get_se_phr
methods.description: Returns the single entry power headroom report.

methods.name: set_se_phr
methods.description: Sets the report as a single entry PHR, validating cell ID, PH type, and maximum power.

methods.name: is_se_phr
methods.description: Checks if the PHR is a single entry report with PH type1.

methods.name: get_phr
methods.description: Returns the list of cell PH reports.
